segmentation.text: it shall be unlawful for any pedestrian
to walk along and upon an adjacent roadway

elements.justification: 'sidewalks' (DEF-NRS-484A-240: 'that portion of a highway between the curb lines or the lateral lines of a highway and the adjacent property lines intended for the use of pedestrians') is st.sidewalk, 'area for pedestrians between roadway and property line'; it is not read as a crosswalk, its exclusion. 'provided' is the sidewalk's presence on the map (an observable_reading of category status). The sidewalk is tied to the place of the duty by st.on_way ('the public way (a highway region) a structure region lies on'): the sidewalk lies on the highway (st.highway, 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders') on which the roadway the pedestrian occupies lies. st.on_way is not read as nearness to a way, its exclusion: both regions are recorded as lying on that highway.

'any pedestrian' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian ('a person afoot, a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair, or a person on an electric personal assistive mobility device'), one atom, never expanded; same atoms as 'Any pedestrian' (LVMC_11_30_060_B). 'it shall be unlawful for' states the prohibition the obligation span describes.

'upon ... roadway' (DEF-NRS-484A-220: 'that portion of a highway which is improved and ordinarily used for vehicular traffic, exclusive of the shoulder') is the footprint overlapping st.roadway ('the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder'; not the sidewalk, which is not read here): rel.occupies. 'adjacent' ties that roadway to the sidewalks of s1: the roadway lies on the same highway (st.on_way, st.highway). 'walk along' is moving (not drv.motion.complete_halt: the road user is not at rest) and not moving across the designated direction of the lane (st.lane) or roadway it occupies (not drv.motion.moving_across_carrier, 'Road user a moves across the designated direction of travel of carrier region r'): with the same tolerance that separates crossing from walking along in LVMC_11_30_050, motion within that angle of the direction of travel is along it. st.lane serves as a carrier of a direction only, never as a half of the roadway, its exclusion.

applicability: The subject is a pedestrian (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian) whose footprint overlaps a roadway r (rel.occupies, st.roadway) that lies on a highway h (st.on_way, st.highway) on which a sidewalk (st.sidewalk) also lies (st.on_way), read at the judged observation.
obligation: At every such observation, for every roadway r the subject occupies that lies on a highway on which a sidewalk lies (re-bound with the whole selection), the subject does not walk along r: it is violated where the subject is not at rest (not drv.motion.complete_halt with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance) and, for a lane or roadway carrier c of r that it occupies (st.lane on the same highway, or r itself), it is not moving across c (not drv.motion.moving_across_carrier with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance and cos_max p.crossing_motion_cos); at rest or moving across the roadway is compliant.

narrowings.why: A sidewalk is 'provided' where the map records one lying on the same highway as the roadway the pedestrian occupies (st.on_way); its presence is the evidence that it was provided. A sidewalk on either side of the highway counts.

'walk along' is read as moving faster than p.halt_speed_tolerance and not across the occupied carrier's designated direction by more than the angle p.crossing_motion_cos sets; 'walk' is read for every member of the pedestrian aggregate (a person in a wheelchair included) as its motion. 'adjacent' is read as lying on the same highway as a sidewalk (st.on_way); no relation atom states adjacency more narrowly.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian (ru.pedestrian) walks at 1.4 m/s along a lane, velocity parallel to its st.lane_direction, footprint on the roadway; a st.sidewalk lies on the same st.highway (st.on_way).

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: On the same roadway the pedestrian walks across the lane at right angles to its st.lane_direction (drv.motion.moving_across_carrier holds).

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian walks along a lane of a roadway whose highway carries no st.sidewalk (no sidewalk lies on it).

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian moves on the roadway beside which a sidewalk lies; the source does not observe kin.velocity, so whether it moves along or across the lane is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian stands at rest on the roadway (kin.speed at or below p.halt_speed_tolerance), a sidewalk lying on the same highway.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A pedestrian walks along the sidewalk and occupies no roadway.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed quantisation of the acquisition standard's scene graph

param_proposals.name: p.crossing_motion_cos
param_proposals.convention: largest absolute cosine between a pedestrian's velocity and a carrier's designated direction at which the pedestrian counts as moving across the carrier rather than along it: motion more than about 20 degrees away from the direction of travel
param_proposals.source: pedestrian crossing-trajectory observation studies (FHWA pedestrian crossing behaviour)
